name: Data or engineering defect
about: Report a reproducible correctness, source-quality or documentation problem.
title: "[defect] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Expected and observed behaviour

State the affected module/claim and why it matters. Missing data is not zero.

## Reproduction

Provide source commit, environment, exact commands and the smallest synthetic or
permitted fixture. Remove tokens, account identifiers and private records.

## Data context

Where relevant: provider, observation/release dates, units, currency, return basis,
vintage, retrieval method and hashes. Is the problem isolated or systematic?

## Suggested regression check

Describe a stable test that fails before the repair. Do not post exploitable secrets
or sensitive security details publicly; use a private reporting route where available.
